regime.call: Semis-led risk-off broadens into Taiwan; volatility spikes
contradicts: Credit markets show no stress despite a 6.03% TAIEX drop and a 5.28% SOX drop: HYG fell only 0.27% and LQD fell 0.01%, raising the question of whether this is a contained AI/semis positioning unwind rather than a genuine macro risk-off.

falsifiers.threshold: Closes down more than 1% in a single session
falsifiers.meaning: Would show credit stress spreading beyond equities, confirming a broader deleveraging event rather than a contained sector unwind.
Would confirm volatility has moved from 'rising' into genuine stress territory, strengthening the case for a systemic regime shift.
Would show Taiwan's slide is accelerating rather than a one-day catch-down, deepening regional semis/AI-infrastructure risk.

regime.for_w52_engine: QQQ fell further and SMH underperformed sharply again this week as SOX dropped 5.28% and Taiwan's TAIEX fell 6.03%, among its largest point declines on record; see the live page for the Supertrend line values.
regime.confidence_reason: Equity and volatility stress is sharp and now broadening geographically into Taiwan, but credit markets (HYG, LQD) and the liquidity composite show no parallel deterioration, capping conviction that this is a systemic regime shift.

review.yesterday_call: Semis-led risk-off deepens on hawkish Fed repricing, Taiwan diverges
review.note: Taiwan's divergence from the US semis selloff closed decisively today (TAIEX -6.03%, SOX -5.28%), so today's call drops the divergence framing and treats the move as a broadening global semis/AI event rather than a US-only, Fed-driven one.
